reason: The named lab and batch report are exactly what I look for, but $25 to $30 a month is a lot on my budget when I can get magnesium bisglycinate in a bottle for much less. I also forget my vitamins half the time, so I would be paying for 30 sachets I might not finish.
objection: Too much money for something I might forget to take, and 30 foil sachets is a lot of packaging waste for two capsules each.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 for the 30 days, or a bottle option with the same lab report so there is no sachet waste.
